name: Lahinch Limos
title: A booking site for a chauffeur service on Ireland's Wild Atlantic Way
summary: The WordPress/Elementor site for a chauffeur company in North Clare, presenting its services with a three-step booking form for transfers, hourly hire and tours.
problem: A local chauffeur business needed a site that sells chauffeur hire, airport transfers, private tours, luggage transfers and group trips, and collects bookings with enough detail to quote and assign a vehicle.

constraints.label: Owner-editable
constraints.text: Built in Elementor so the owner can update content without a developer.

constraints.label: Usable bookings
constraints.text: Every booking includes trip type, date, time, route, passengers, luggage and preferred vehicle.

architecture.caption: Visitors go from the service pages to a multi-step form that collects the trip, vehicle choice and contact details.

sections.heading: Site and booking flow
paras: Home, About, Services, Blog, FAQ, Contact and Book Now pages. The booking form runs in three steps: trip details (type, date, time, pickup, drop-off, hours, passengers, suitcases), vehicle choice, and contact details.

challenges.title: No same-day bookings
challenges.text: A small script hooks into the form's date picker and sets the earliest date to tomorrow, so customers can't request a same-day pickup.

outcome: The site is live and takes structured booking requests across three booking types, alongside service, FAQ and blog content.
